title: Duration between rewards controls the rate of behavioral and dopaminergic learning
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Model number of trials until conditioned responding across ITIs 30, 60, 300, 600 and 3,600 seconds. This source model endpoint is one part of the paper’s behavior/dopamine learning claims.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Model number of trials until conditioned responding across ITIs 30, 60, 300, 600 and 3,600 seconds. This source model endpoint is one part of the paper’s behavior/dopamine learning claims.

Source-paper comparison for Original raw-scale AIC model comparison, with log-space RSS selection reported separately: Selection RSS sums (log observed trials-to-learn − log mean predicted trials-to-learn)^2, omitting NaNs and assigning infinite loss to missing predictions. Reported AIC instead uses nAnimals×log(raw-scale mean squared error)+2k. These are different ordered metrics; the main source comparison uses k=0 with alternative penalties also calculated.
success_criteria: Recover and reproduce the numeric original ANCCR/comparator score vector, complete animal roster and all five ITI conditions.
Preserve original in-sample fit/selection procedure, missingness/censoring and the correct AIC penalty convention; do not conflate log-RSS selection with raw-scale AIC.

Freeze the entire registered behavior/dopamine scope or explicitly limit any result claim to the recovered original model endpoint; the 60/600-second subset alone cannot satisfy full-paper superiority.
Predeclare a scientifically meaningful model-fit improvement, uncertainty rule and equal concrete access/compute budgets before final scoring.
Label an animal-held-out or new-schedule result as an extension with a separately rerun author comparator.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
